msg: Liquibase 5.0.0 and later ship under FSL-1.1-ALv2 (Functional Source License), not Apache-2.0. Flyway: replace it with <flyway.version>13.10.0</flyway.version> (Flyway Community, Apache-2.0).
msg_v4: Liquibase 4.x is Apache-2.0 (4.33.0 is the last 4.x), but the next major bump by Dependabot or Renovate pulls 5.x under FSL-1.1-ALv2. Flyway: <flyway.version>13.10.0</flyway.version>, or pin Liquibase below 5.
msg_converted: Under FSL each version turns Apache-2.0 two years after its release; this exact version has passed that date, newer 5.x releases have not. Flyway: <flyway.version>13.10.0</flyway.version>.

msg: liquibase-core dependency. Flyway: <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId> <artifactId>flyway-core</artifactId>, plus the database module, e.g. flyway-database-postgresql.
liquibase-maven-plugin. Flyway: <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId> <artifactId>flyway-maven-plugin</artifactId> and run mvn flyway:migrate.
Liquibase Gradle plugin. Flyway: plugins { id "org.flywaydb.flyway" } and run gradle flywayMigrate.

Liquibase changelog setting. Flyway has no master changelog; it reads versioned SQL files from locations: <locations><location>classpath:db/migration</location></locations> or spring.flyway.locations.
Liquibase contexts or labels. Flyway has no per-changeset contexts; give each environment its own location (db/migration plus db/prod) and list them in locations.
Liquibase rollback. Flyway undo migrations are a Flyway Teams/Enterprise feature, not Community; plan a forward fix migration (V<n+1>__revert_x.sql) instead.
Liquibase Secure (commercial) licence key setting. Remove it once the Flyway migration is live, and note the seat in the licence review.
Liquibase changelog file. Flyway: export the current schema once as V1__baseline.sql in db/migration and set baselineOnMigrate for existing databases.
Liquibase formatted SQL. Flyway reads plain SQL: rename the file V<n>__<description>.sql and drop the --changeset lines.
Spring Boot spring.liquibase.* setting. Flyway: the matching spring.flyway.* key (enabled, default-schema, user, password, url).
Liquibase extension or LPM call (5.0 ships without extensions and drivers). Flyway: add the database module instead, e.g. org.flywaydb:flyway-database-postgresql.
